statement: Every noncuspidal continuous section of the full arithmetic fundamental group of P1_Q minus {0,1,infinity}, and of every geometrically connected finite etale cover of this curve, has local points integral at a set of primes of Dirichlet density one and asymptotically integral: for each n the ordinary boundary intersection multiplicities are divisible by n outside a finite set. No birational lifting assumption is imposed, and cofinite integrality is not asserted.

notes: Root independently reviewed the full arithmetic proof and exact primary Stix passages, including the locally split cuspidal case, before promotion. The geometric cusp inertia remains nontrivial even when the section arithmetic inertia is trivial; its unique chi-normalized line is used. A single almost-everywhere local nth-power level is insufficient (16 at n=8), but compatibility at every level forces the completed rational class to vanish. The finite-support step imposes support only at finite places, with the real component convention retained. A finite etale cover preserves noncuspidality by cusp decomposition intersections and preserves integral local points outside a finite set by finite normalization. No arbitrary branched cover, arbitrary twist, cofinite integrality, or full D1-D4 conclusion follows. Exact matrix and residue certificate is in code/D_legendre_density_certificate.py and audit/D_legendre_density_certificate.json.

statement: For every number field k, a completed multiplicative Kummer class that is an nth power locally at almost every finite place for each n is trivial, with the finite exceptional set allowed to depend on n. Consequently every noncuspidal continuous section of the three-punctured line over k, and every geometrically connected finite etale cover thereof, is asymptotically integral and integral at a set of finite places of Dirichlet density one, without a birational lifting assumption.
